title: Absolute Necromancer
altTitles: 死灵法师：重生的我全技能精通
死靈法師：重生的我全技能精通
オールマスター・ネクロマンサー
ออลมาสเตอร์ เนโครแมนเซอร์
description: The Tower is an unknown place filled with constantly changing dangers. Ten years after reaching the top as a necromancer and becoming a Spirit Master, Cha Jinhyuk reincarnates into the body of a boy living in South Korea. Determined to take revenge on the person who betrayed him and the one above them, the former All-Master begins climbing the Tower again as a necromancer.
author: Chung Song / Blue Jaeng-i
